rules: Finish selection must use this product finish_variants only; keep body and accent materials separate.
A beverage faucet can be mounted on an island, but location does not turn it into a hot/cold prep faucet.
Add matching accessory chooses the actual accessory SKU. Never resize the main faucet to create a small faucet.
Keep placements independent. Do not automatically drill holes, place water connections or replace existing sink/faucet.
Clone component definitions/materials per finish when needed; changing one instance must not recolor all existing models.
Persist immutable selection snapshot: product/handle SKU, geometry revision/hash, finish/material map, function, connection, anchor and transform. Data, 2D and 3D must read the same snapshot.
Render/SketchUp colors approximate the finish under different lighting; no claim of physical color calibration.
Do not present proof of manifold topology as proof of exact manufacturer geometry or plumbing fit.
